It is the RELEASE gate: an entry with an unresolved (`UNKNOWN`) license, an out-of-vocabulary `source_kind`, or a missing `source_ref` refuses generation outright rather than shipping. One section below per DISTINCT license carried by the shipped lock; each entry lists its footprint ref and its acquisition `source_ref`. - `Connector_PinSocket_2.54mm:PinSocket_1x20_P2.54mm_Vertical_SMD_Wcon2171_TYPE2` — authored 2026-08-15 from the Wcon 2171 manufacturer drawing (LCSC C920840 datasheet, 600dpi render): pitch 2.54, pad 1.02x1.90, 5.20 across outer pad edges, TYPE 2 phase (pin 1 tail up), contact-centreline NPTH dia 1.02 (smart-remote v2b: J6/J7 ESP32-S3-DevKitC socket. TYPE 2 selected because both stocked part numbers end -2. Butt-joining a 1x20+1x4 is IMPOSSIBLE (housing = 2.54N+0.20 gives 1.37mm end walls -> 0.20mm interference), so a single 1x20 is used and 2 DevKit pins overhang onto clearance holes.)
- `Connector_PinSocket_2.54mm:PinSocket_1x22_P2.54mm_Vertical_HC-PM254-8.5H` — authored in-repo from the manufacturer drawing CS-1165SDIG-1x22 (LCSC C41376161 datasheet, 600dpi render): pitch 2.54±0.15, pin span B=53.34 for 1x22, housing A+0.4 = 56.28 long x 2.40 wide, H=8.5, pin 0.64x0.40, recommended PCB layout hole dia 1.02 on 2.54 pitch (Geometry is read off the drawing FIGURE, not its dimension table alone: the table gives A/B per circuit count, the figure says which arrow each letter labels (B is pin centre to pin centre, A+0.4 the housing). The drawing marks NO pin 1 — every cavity and every recommended hole is drawn alike — so the rect pad 1, fab chamfer and silk tick are this library's convention. Title block is ShenZhen YongFengYing Electronics (CST), engineering no. CS-1165SDIG; LCSC lists the part under Hong Cheng.)

- `Sunlord:L_Sunlord_AMWPH4018_4x4x1.8mm` — authored 2026-08-31 from the Sunlord AMWPH4018S series datasheet, Fig.3-1 and Table 3-1: A=B=4.0, C=1.8, D=3.3, E=1.1, a=1.2, b=1.8, c=3.7. READ THE FIGURE: 'a' is the GAP BETWEEN PADS and 'b' is EACH PAD'S WIDTH, not the other way round. Both orderings give the same +/-1.5 centres, so the arithmetic self-checks either way and a swap is invisible - it was caught only by zooming into Fig.3-1 and seeing which edges the extension lines drop from. Verified in KiCad 9.0.9 and 10.0.5. (smart-remote v2 rev B: L1 buck inductor, replacing the Vishay-named land. Pads 1.8 x 3.7 at +/-1.5 span x 0.6 to 2.4 against a terminal at 0.9 to 2.0 - 0.3 inboard and 0.4 outboard, where the fillet forms. NOTE the old Inductor_SMD:L_Vishay_IFSC-1515AH land (1.15 wide at +/-1.475, spanning 0.9 to 2.05) covers the termination but gives far less fillet than Sunlord specifies; an earlier 'verified drop-in, no board change' assessment of it rested on the swapped a/b reading and was wrong. Non-polar, nothing on F.Fab past the body outline, anchor (0, 0).)
- `Syntiant:SPK0641HT4H-1_TopPort_LGA-8_4x3mm` — authored 2026-08-31 from the Syntiant SPK0641HT4H-1 datasheet Rev D-1, MECHANICAL SPECIFICATIONS 'Example Land Pattern': 2.750 x 3.750 overall, four inner pads 0.45x0.95 on 0.85 x 1.35 centres, ground bars 1.30x0.325 top/bottom and 0.325x2.30 left/right, every pad-to-pad gap 0.40. Cross-checked pad-for-pad against the SnapEDA vendor export for LCSC C5159510: all 8 pads agree to within 1e-6 mm. Datasheet chamfers (8X 0.1 x 45 deg) are omitted - they only widen the 0.40 corner gaps. (smart-remote v2 rev B: U3 microphone, replacing MEMSensing:MSM261S4030H0R_TopPort_LGA-8_4x3mm. TOP PORT so no PCB acoustic hole. SAME body and footprint name shape as the MSM261 but a DIFFERENT pinout - pad 8 is GROUND here and was +3V3 on the MSM261 layout, so reusing the old net map shorts the mic rail. PDM output, not I2S: pad 1 DATA, pad 2 CLOCK. Pad 3 SELECT is internally pulled low (left channel); tie it to GND to make that explicit. Pads 5-8 are all GROUND. The CPL rotation for this land is now MEASURED, not assumed: pcb/library/part_orientation.json records our drawing as the vendor's (LCSC C5159510) turned 180 deg counter-clockwise. It has still not been verified against an assembled board. The F.Fab pin-1 marker sits INSIDE the body outline on purpose: the compiler takes its anchor from the fab extent first (assembly_anchor), so a marker poking past the outline would shift every placed part - it measured -0.0925mm in x before this was corrected.)

## Source-embedded third-party data tables

Data tables — glyph outlines, lookup tables, coefficient sets — taken from a third-party source and stored as literal constants inside this project's own source files. The footprint inventory above cannot see these: it inventories acquired FILES, and a table of constants inside a source file is not a file. This section is the second inventory, and it is maintained by hand in `EMBEDDED_DATA_TABLES` in `pcb/scripts/gen_notice.py`.
